headline: Anthropic shuts loopholes Chinese firms used to reach Claude
body: A quiet day. The FT reported Anthropic is cracking down on Chinese companies reaching Claude through Singapore-linked accounts and VPNs. A wider US-China split weakens Global Coordination, trimming Gatekeeper and nudging Self-Destruction up. Nothing else was scored, so other lines only drifted as older stories faded. Horizon Balance: +2.03.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.2, from Anthropic closing loopholes (-0.13) and fading earlier news (-0.04). Self-Destruction +0.07, from Anthropic closing loopholes (+0.09), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03). Enslaved God -0.06, from fading earlier news (-0.06).
